news.title: Private Banks Outshine Nifty 50 In Earnings Upgrades; HSBC Sees More Room For Growth, Prefers ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, Kotak
news.summary: Among the four lenders, ICICI Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank have witnessed the strongest earnings upgrade momentum, while Axis Bank and HDFC Bank have lagged
